consequence.statement: Conflict resolution for duplicate-hostname services and multiple Gateway API routes now follows a unified order (same namespace as proxy first, then Kubernetes Service over ServiceEntry), so the selected service or route may differ from before.

assertion.statement: Istio unifies service conflict resolution (same-hostname services, Gateway API routes) so behavior is the same with or without a Sidecar resource, changing which service or route is picked.
